The project is positioned as 'Resort Living' under Israel Canada's Better & Different strategy.
It includes one 39-floor luxury tower and six 8-floor boutique buildings.
The official structured pages list 7 buildings and 459 housing units.
The architect is Bar Orian? No: the official Hebrew page names ברעלי לויצקי כסיף דה לה פונטיין; the English page calls the architect D-blk Architects.

source_backed_story_facts.value: Interior design is by Orly Shrem Architects.

The annual report places the project in Sde Dov, Gush 6634, parts of parcels 15, 164, 169, 208, 209, 312, 314 and 324.
A full building permit was reported as received on 30 Sep 2025.
The first occupancy is marketed for 2030, while the annual report says completion is expected in stages from 2029/2030.
The report states marketing and branding expense growth was mainly due to Rainbow, making it a strong observable advertising-budget proxy.
